verdicts.reason: A keeps the right reading order (headline, subcopy, CTA) inside the blue panel. But the panel is off-centre, the CTA floats right of centre under a large empty gap, and the small white Meridian logo nearly vanishes against the pale sky. B buries everything in an oversized panel that is mostly dead blue space. Its CTA floats in the middle, and the logo and a tiny, barely legible subline are jammed into the bottom corner, which breaks the brand-first reading order and the hierarchy.
